2.10.title: Gemini, OpenCode and your own API
2.10.text: Gemini and OpenCode join Claude, ChatGPT and Grok, and any OpenAI- or Claude-compatible API works too.

2.10.title: Setup in four steps
2.10.text: Connect your AI, make a companion and give it a first task, all in one go.

2.10.title: Make them look your way
2.10.text: Pick a body, colors, a face and extras in the new look editor.

2.10.title: See what they remember
2.10.text: Every fact a companion keeps, with where it came from. Change or forget any of it.

2.10.title: Undo when you delete
2.10.text: Deleting a chat, a companion or your data asks first, then gives you a few seconds to undo.
